name: Structured
one_liner: Visual day planner that puts tasks, events and routines on one timeline; popular with people who have ADHD. Free core app, paid Pro.
best_for: Adults with ADHD who find lists hard and prefer seeing the day as a timeline
People who want to time-block their day and build routines
People who want a planner that works without signing up
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People looking for ADHD diagnosis, treatment or coaching
People who need shared team calendars or project management
short_description: A visual day planner with a timeline of tasks and events, focus timer and widgets. Free core app; Pro adds calendar sync and routines.
long_description: Structured is a planner app from unorderly GmbH in Germany. You see your day as a timeline instead of a list, drag tasks into place, capture ideas in an inbox and use a focus timer and widgets to stay on track. The core planner is free; Structured Pro adds calendar import, recurring routines, cloud sync and automatic rescheduling of missed tasks, with prices that vary by region (reviews in 2026 report about $6.99 a month, $29.99 a year or $99.99 lifetime in the US). It is not a clinical tool and has not been studied for ADHD; many people with ADHD use it because it makes time visible.
patient_summary: Structured shows your day as a timeline so you can see how tasks and events fit together, drag them around, and get reminders as you go. The basic planner is free; Pro is an optional subscription or one-time purchase.

pricing.notes: Core planner free. Pro price depends on region; US prices from 2026 reviews. A lifetime purchase doesn't cancel an existing subscription.

privacy.notes: Says it does not sell data or track you; anonymous analytics can be turned off. Account optional; Structured Cloud sync (servers in Frankfurt) can be deleted in settings. Google Play lists device IDs shared for analytics.

seo.meta_description: Structured is a visual day planner that puts tasks, events and routines on one timeline, popular with people who have ADHD.

faqs.a: Free; Pro about $9.99–$49.99/year or $99.99 lifetime. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Structured before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Structured replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Structured is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.
Structured is available on iPhone and Android.
Visual daily timeline; Inbox for quick capture; Focus timer and widgets; Pro: calendar sync and routines.

primary_uses: Planning your day on a visual timeline
